description: PY24OCT_E001 is supported by one ABC Color report quoting a police estimate. Independent corroboration, specific policy demands, episode end and state-response detail remain unresolved. A second ABC Color article describes a CNI contingent at the same Agriculture Ministry demonstration but is same-publisher context, not independent corroboration. A same-day ABC Color report provides same-publisher context; a separate 15 October pro-paving gathering is documented by Última Hora with an approximate 200-person count.
required_followup: Search independent contemporary local/regional media and CNI communications; verify whether later reports describe same gathering and its end.

description: ABC Color reports a separate INDERT encampment of approximately two months and a July 26 arrival, plus newly arrived groups. Exact episode identity, demands and relationship among groups are unresolved.
required_followup: Check July/August/September ownership and October continuity in available unit records and independent reports; do not count the longstanding encampment as an October-start event.

description: ABC Color announced >100 FNC delegates would protest at MOPC on 15 October. The same article reports CNI/campesino groups already demonstrating on 14 October, but does not verify the planned next-day action.
required_followup: Search independent contemporary reports or FNC statements to verify whether the 15 October MOPC protest occurred and its actual size/demands; do not treat the announcement as an event.

description: The Oct 15 event is supported by an event-day report and likely relates to an Oct 14 FNC announcement about a paving protest, but the commission-to-FNC relationship and hearing/outcome are unresolved.
required_followup: Find post-hearing reporting or organizer records; confirm group relation and whether the event ended or continued.

description: A 14 Oct Caaguazú tomato-farmer road blockade is confirmed by ABC and UH. ABC reports approximately 50; UH supplies no count. Closure intervals differ. Relationship with later Nov actions unresolved. OviedoPress body excluded due sequencing error.
required_followup: Verify simultaneous count, meeting outcome and relation to Nov actions.

description: Aug 27 ABC article describes about 45 Santa Teresa family heads at Tacuary and 94 families awaiting land. Relation to July-start group from Oct and August-start camp in Dec unresolved.
required_followup: Compare group names/start dates/counts, use only assessed sources, retain OviedoPress deviation without retry.
